items.text: Khaleah K. Bradshaw was elected City Clerk of Carson in 2022. Before taking office, she was the director of government and community relations at Cal State Dominguez Hills. At an October 2026 candidate forum, she discussed the importance of accessible public records and reviewed voter registration and election deadlines. In her 2022 campaign, she said her goals included making more clerk services available online, improving cybersecurity for digital records, and improving communication between city departments.
